name: Ne po scenariju...
source: Hello, Pioneer! You've always been building theories about what was in the original Miku-ruta BL. This mod will tell you about the secrets of the camp with the directors and with the Zombies Ulyanka, Crazy Lena. In this mod, the main character is not Semyon, the Screenwriter, but also not an ordinary Semyon, but Semyon, who has already gone through about 300 cycles, but who has not yet completely lost his mind: he still has the strength to fight insanity. But it's up to you to decide what happens to him. Will he become a completely deranged Pioneer who decides to make fun of dolls with Lena and the Ulyankas, or will he come to his senses? Perhaps this is his last chance to get out of the cycles of the Owl.
translation: 你好啊，少先队员！你一定一直在构想各种理论，猜测《永恒之夏》原版初音线里究竟发生过什么吧。本模组将为你揭晓营地里的种种秘密——关于幕后导演，也关于丧尸化的小乌里扬娜与疯癫的列娜。在本模组中，主角既不是“编剧谢苗”，也不是普通的谢苗，而是已经经历了大约300次轮回、却尚未彻底丧失理智的谢苗：他体内依然残存着与疯狂抗争的力量。但他最终将迎来怎样的结局，全由你来定夺。他是会彻底沦为精神失常的少先队员，跑去跟列娜和乌里扬娜们一起拿人偶寻欢作乐，还是能够重拾清醒？或许，这正是他挣脱“猫头鹰”营地无尽轮回的最后一次机会。
